uslaw-usc-t1-s1:
Section 1 of Title 1 of the United States Code sets rules for how words in acts of Congress are to be read. It sits in Chapter 1 of that title, on rules of construction. Unless the context shows a different sense, set rules hold. Words in the singular cover several persons, parties, or things as well. Words in the plural cover the singular in turn.

Words of the masculine gender cover the feminine as well. Words used in the present tense cover the future as well as the present. The terms insane and insane person are stated to cover each idiot and insane person, as the list goes on. The text is current through Public Law 119-134.
